def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,0)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    motif=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    zpts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    zr0=min(r for r,c in zpts); zc0=min(c for r,c in zpts)
    for dr in range(r1-r0+1):
        for dc in range(c1-c0+1):
            g[zr0+dr][zc0+dc]=motif[dr][len(motif[0])-1-dc]
    return g
